name: Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A.
summary: Equatorial Pará Distribuidora de Energia S.A. supplies power to a diverse customer base, including households, industrial sites, commercial businesses, corporations, and rural areas, across the state of Pará. Its expansive network covers five key regions—Belém, Castanhal, Marabá, Santarém, and Altamira—reaching 144 municipalities and serving an estimated 8.6 million individuals. Established in 1902, the company is headquartered in Belém, Brazil, and operates as a subsidiary of Equatorial Energia S.A.
